dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.desc: Central control panel for your server. View message, voice, member, wallet, and tag/booster metrics for the last 24 hours and all time.
dashboard.tip1: Use the refresh button to update stats instantly.
dashboard.tip2: Quick Actions cards provide shortcuts to the most used pages.
dashboard.tip3: Tag owner and booster counts help measure community engagement.

store.title: Store Management
store.desc: Manage Discord role products, papel promotion codes, and percentage discount codes from one place.
store.tip1: When creating a product, search by role name; the bot fills the role ID automatically.
store.tip2: Promotion codes grant papel with optional usage limits and expiry.
store.tip3: Discount codes are percentage-based and apply to store purchases.
store.tip4: Inactive products stay listed but cannot be purchased — ideal for temporary disable.

earn.title: Earning Settings
earn.desc: Configure message and voice earn rates, tag/booster bonuses, verification role, and channel filters (all/whitelist/blacklist).
earn.tip1: If verification role is empty, all members earn; otherwise only members with that role.
earn.tip2: Tag requirements need Discord tag configuration on the server.
earn.tip3: Channel mode limits earning to specific text/voice channels or categories.
earn.tip4: Use Undo before saving to revert to the last saved state.

wallet.title: Wallet Management
wallet.desc: Add or remove papel for a single user or all members. Preset message templates, required descriptions, and automatic notification mail are supported.
wallet.tip1: Description is required when adding papel; the {amount} placeholder is filled automatically.
wallet.tip2: User search works by nickname or username.
wallet.tip3: Bulk operations affect every member balance — use with care.

logs.title: Channels & Logs
logs.desc: Route member and admin events to separate webhook channels. Auth, roles, store, wallet, notification, and settings logs can be tracked individually.
logs.tip1: The same webhook URL cannot be assigned to multiple channels — the system prevents this.
logs.tip2: Use Webhook Test to verify the connection before saving.
logs.tip3: Member channels: main, auth, roles, exchange, store. Admin channels: main, wallet, store, notifications, settings.
logs.tip4: Inactive channels receive no logs; use is_active for temporary disable.

community.title: Tag & Booster
community.desc: Define tag badge tiers and booster reward layers. Day/month requirements, papel rewards, earn multipliers, and role assignment are configurable.
community.tip1: On Tag Settings, create tiers with sort order, emoji, and background image.
community.tip2: Booster Settings provides reward tiers based on server boost duration.
community.tip3: Tag/booster bonuses in Earning Settings work together with these tiers.

settings.title: Server Settings
settings.desc: Manage admin role, verified member role, approval threshold, and referral reward. Accessed from the Panel Settings menu.
settings.tip1: Admin role controls panel access; the bot role must sit above it.
settings.tip2: Verified member role controls store and earning access.
settings.tip3: Remove setup resets the server connection — use only when necessary.

maintenance.title: Maintenance Mode
maintenance.desc: Put site, store, transactions, promotions, discounts, transfers, bot, and activity flows into maintenance separately.
maintenance.tip1: Granular flags let you disable only the affected module.
maintenance.tip2: Each change is recorded with updater and timestamp.

announcements.title: Global Announcement
announcements.desc: Create announcements visible to all DiscoWeb users. Title, body, detail URL, and media image are supported.
announcements.tip1: Title and body are required; image and detail link are optional.
announcements.tip2: Published announcements are platform-wide — use carefully.

security.title: Security Center
security.desc: Best practices for role hierarchy, webhook management, service role key, and suspicious event monitoring.
security.tip2: Only trusted admin staff should manage webhook URLs.
security.tip3: The bot role must be positioned above every role it assigns automatically.

access.q: Who can access the admin panel?
access.a: Discord members with the admin role defined in Server Settings can access the panel. The role can be set in-panel or via DISCORD_ADMIN_ROLE_ID.

roles.q: Role search returns nothing — what should I do?
roles.a: Type at least 2 characters. Ensure the bot can read the guild role list and its role sits above the target role.

logs.q: Logs are not appearing on Discord — what should I check?
logs.a: Verify the webhook URL is valid, the channel is active (is_active), and the URL is not used elsewhere. Test with Webhook Test.

orders.a: The bot may be offline, role hierarchy may be wrong, or the target role may sit above the bot role. Check that store maintenance mode is off.

earn.q: Members cannot earn papel — what are likely causes?
earn.a: Check that message/voice earning is enabled in Earning Settings, verification role requirements, channel filters (whitelist/blacklist), and tag requirements.

wallet.q: No mail after a wallet operation?
wallet.a: Removal operations use the admin mail API. Check the API response; addition operations send reward mail via the bot.
